source: hand-shaped from live answers, 2026-10-02: the live cleaner test's recording rp-w34-rec-cleaner-20261002T210555 (graph/005: GET of the message its repeated permanentDelete, graph/004, was refused 403 ErrorCannotDeleteObject; answered 200 although the final Inbox listing was empty) and read-only probes (GET /users/{mailbox}/messages/{id}?$select=id,parentFolderId,subject with Prefer IdType="ImmutableId": 200).
